title: Deep learning in medical imaging and radiation therapy

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep learning in medical imaging and radiation therapy》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The goals of this review paper on deep learning (DL) in medical imaging and radiation therapy are to (a) summarize what has been achieved to date; (b) identify common and unique challenges, and strategies that researchers have taken to address these challenges; and (c) identify some of the promising avenues for the future both in terms of applications as well as technical innovations.
